about: The Edgeville Dungeon's Wilderness part, north of the gate at z 9917 (Wilderness step W2.1): chaos druids (13), thugs (10), deadly red spiders (34), earth warriors (51, past the monkey bars), skeletons (45), poison spiders (64) and black demons (172). Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live), which match the OSRS Wiki's Edgeville Dungeon page's counts for the northern half (read 2026-11-15). Left out: Chronozon (Family Crest, and every quest counts as done) and the Mysterious ghost. Every wander range is guessed until recorded.
